{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793157005267,"sessionID":"ses_e7f8712a0ffevs78WBsYrZHx2k","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01QUKW5Hk7XsjaerdRu6SmnV","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/unstructured_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_hybrid_r5/unstructured/unstructured.cpp","content":"// Unstructured mesh energy transfer benchmark.\n//\n// Parallelization (hybrid, all three always active):\n//   * MPI     - the global element index space is block-partitioned across ranks.\n//               Each rank owns a contiguous slice of elements and exchanges only the\n//               energy values of \"ghost\" neighbours with the ranks that own them.\n//   * CUDA    - each rank drives one GPU. The per-element update is a data-parallel\n//               kernel. Elements whose neighbours are all local (\"interior\") are\n//               updated concurrently with the halo exchange; elements that depend on\n//               ghost values (\"boundary\") are updated once the halo has arrived.\n//   * OpenMP  - host-side construction of the local mesh, connectivity and the\n//               ghost/communication plan is multi-threaded.\n//\n// Numerical semantics are identical to the sequential reference: every time step is\n// a Jacobi-style update (all reads come from the previous state), and every element\n// accumulates its fluxes in the same order with the same floating-point operations.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Types to represent unstructured mesh elements\nusing idx_t = uint64_t;\nusing val_t = double;\n\n// Maximum number of connections per element (for a 2D grid: 4 neighbors)\nconstexpr int MAX_CONNECTIONS = 8;\n// Maximum number of distinct materials supported by the device kernel\nconstexpr int MAX_MATERIALS = 8;\n// CUDA thread block size\nconstexpr unsigned CUDA_BLOCK = 256;\n\n// Material properties for energy transfer\nstruct Material {\n    val_t transfer_coeff;  // Energy transfer coefficient\n    val_t external_flow;   // External energy source/sink\n};\n\n// Static connectivity information for each element\nstruct ElementStatic {\n    idx_t material_idx;\n    idx_t num_connections;\n    idx_t connected_idx[MAX_CONNECTIONS];     // Indices of connected elements (global ids)\n    val_t connected_flux[MAX_CONNECTIONS];    // Flux coefficients for each connection\n};\n\n// Dynamic state for each element\nstruct ElementDynamic {\n    val_t current_energy;\n    val_t total_flux;\n};\n\n// Host-side mesh of the locally owned elements\nstruct World {\n    std::vector<Material> materials;\n    std::vector<ElementStatic> elements_static;  // local partition only\n};\n\n// Material type IDs\nconstexpr idx_t DEFAULT_MAT_ID = 0;\nconstexpr idx_t INFLOW_MAT_ID = 1;\nconstexpr idx_t OUTFLOW_MAT_ID = 2;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                              \\\n    do {                                                                              \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                    \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                    \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,          \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                                        \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2);                                             \\\n        }                                                                             \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Partitioning helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// First global element owned by rank r under a block partition of N elements.\nstatic inline idx_t partBegin(int r, int P, idx_t N) {\n    return (N * static_cast<idx_t>(r)) / static_cast<idx_t>(P);\n}\n\n// Rank owning global element g.\nstatic int ownerOf(idx_t g, int P, idx_t N) {\n    int r = static_cast<int>((g * static_cast<idx_t>(P)) / N);\n    if (r >= P) r = P - 1;\n    while (partBegin(r, P, N) > g) --r;\n    while (partBegin(r + 1, P, N) <= g) ++r;\n    return r;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Mesh construction (host, OpenMP over local elements)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Build the static data of the locally owned elements [begin, end) of a 2D\n// n_root x n_root square grid. Connectivity uses global element ids.\nstatic void buildLocalMesh(World& world, const int n_root, const idx_t begin, const idx_t end) {\n    const idx_t n = static_cast<idx_t>(n_root);\n    const idx_t last = n - 1;\n    const idx_t n_local = end - begin;\n\n    // Initialize materials\n    world.materials.clear();\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.0});    // Default material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.5});    // Inflow material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, -0.5});   // Outflow material\n\n    world.elements_static.assign(n_local, ElementStatic{});\n\n    const long long offsets[4][2] = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (idx_t li = 0; li < n_local; ++li) {\n        const idx_t g = begin + li;\n        ElementStatic& elem = world.elements_static[li];\n        elem.material_idx = DEFAULT_MAT_ID;\n        elem.num_connections = 0;\n\n        const long long x = static_cast<long long>(g / n);\n        const long long y = static_cast<long long>(g % n);\n\n        // Connect to neighbors (up, down, left, right) that lie inside the grid\n        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {\n            const long long nx = x + offsets[k][0];\n            const long long ny = y + offsets[k][1];\n            if (nx >= 0 && nx < static_cast<long long>(n) && ny >= 0 && ny < static_cast<long long>(n)) {\n                elem.connected_idx[elem.num_connections] =\n                    static_cast<idx_t>(nx) * n + static_cast<idx_t>(ny);\n                elem.connected_flux[elem.num_connections] = 1.0;\n                elem.num_connections++;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Corner elements are inflow/outflow sources (applied in the original order;\n        // later assignments win when the grid is degenerate)\n        if (g == 0) elem.material_idx = INFLOW_MAT_ID;                 // [0][0]\n        if (g == last) elem.material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;             // [0][last]\n        if (g == last * n) elem.material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;         // [last][0]\n        if (g == last * n + last) elem.material_idx = INFLOW_MAT_ID;   // [last][last]\n    }\n}\n\n// Structure-of-arrays device-ready connectivity of the local partition.\nstruct HostLayout {\n    idx_t begin = 0;\n    idx_t n_local = 0;\n    std::vector<uint8_t> material;     // [i]\n    std::vector<uint8_t> num_conn;     // [i]\n    std::vector<uint32_t> conn_idx;    // [j * n_local + i], extended local index\n    std::vector<val_t> conn_flux;      // [j * n_local + i]\n    std::vector<uint32_t> interior;    // local elements with only local neighbours\n    std::vector<uint32_t> boundary;    // local elements with at least one ghost neighbour\n    std::vector<idx_t> ghosts;         // sorted global ids of remote neighbours\n};\n\n// Translate the global connectivity into local/extended indices. Ghost elements\n// occupy extended slots [n_local, n_local + n_ghost) in ascending global-id order.\nstatic void buildConnectivity(const World& world, const idx_t begin, const idx_t end, HostLayout& L) {\n    const idx_t n_local = end - begin;\n    L.begin = begin;\n    L.n_local = n_local;\n\n    // Collect remote neighbours (per-thread buffers, merged afterwards)\n    std::vector<std::vector<idx_t>> remote(static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_max_threads()));\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        std::vector<idx_t>& mine = remote[static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_thread_num())];\n        #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n        for (idx_t li = 0; li < n_local; ++li) {\n            const ElementStatic& e = world.elements_static[li];\n            for (idx_t j = 0; j < e.num_connections; ++j) {\n                const idx_t nb = e.connected_idx[j];\n                if (nb < begin || nb >= end) mine.push_back(nb);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    L.ghosts.clear();\n    for (const auto& v : remote) L.ghosts.insert(L.ghosts.end(), v.begin(), v.end());\n    std::sort(L.ghosts.begin(), L.ghosts.end());\n    L.ghosts.erase(std::unique(L.ghosts.begin(), L.ghosts.end()), L.ghosts.end());\n\n    const idx_t n_ghost = static_cast<idx_t>(L.ghosts.size());\n    if (n_local + n_ghost >= std::numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Partition too large for 32-bit device indices\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 3);\n    }\n\n    const size_t nl = static_cast<size_t>(n_local);\n    L.material.assign(nl, 0);\n    L.num_conn.assign(nl, 0);\n    L.conn_idx.assign(nl * MAX_CONNECTIONS, 0);\n    L.conn_flux.assign(nl * MAX_CONNECTIONS, 0.0);\n    std::vector<uint8_t> is_boundary(nl, 0);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (idx_t li = 0; li < n_local; ++li) {\n        const ElementStatic& e = world.elements_static[li];\n        L.material[li] = static_cast<uint8_t>(e.material_idx);\n        L.num_conn[li] = static_cast<uint8_t>(e.num_connections);\n        bool bnd = false;\n        for (int j = 0; j < static_cast<int>(e.num_connections); ++j) {\n            const idx_t nb = e.connected_idx[j];\n            uint32_t ext;\n            if (nb >= begin && nb < end) {\n                ext = static_cast<uint32_t>(nb - begin);\n            } else {\n                const auto it = std::lower_bound(L.ghosts.begin(), L.ghosts.end(), nb);\n                ext = static_cast<uint32_t>(n_local + static_cast<idx_t>(it - L.ghosts.begin()));\n                bnd = true;\n            }\n            const size_t k = static_cast<size_t>(j) * nl + static_cast<size_t>(li);\n            L.conn_idx[k] = ext;\n            L.conn_flux[k] = e.connected_flux[j];\n        }\n        is_boundary[li] = bnd ? 1 : 0;\n    }\n\n    L.interior.clear();\n    L.boundary.clear();\n    for (idx_t li = 0; li < n_local; ++li) {\n        (is_boundary[li] ? L.boundary : L.interior).push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(li));\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Halo exchange plan (MPI)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct Plan {\n    std::vector<int> send_count, send_displ;  // per rank: values sent to that rank\n    std::vector<int> recv_count, recv_displ;  // per rank: ghost values received from it\n    std::vector<int> send_peers, recv_peers;  // ranks with nonzero counts\n    std::vector<uint32_t> send_idx;           // local ids of values to pack, peer-ordered\n};\n\nstatic void buildExchangePlan(const HostLayout& L, const idx_t N, const int rank, const int nranks, Plan& p) {\n    (void)rank;\n {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793157010011,"sessionID":"ses_e7f8712a0ffevs78WBsYrZHx2k","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01EFqciurLyVW4qr7uBC1yNB","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/unstructured_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_hybrid_r5/unstructured/CMakeLists.txt","content":"cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)\nproject(unstructured_benchmark LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\n# Target GPU architectures (override with -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=...)\nif(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)\n  set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 70 75 80 86 89 90)\nendif()\n\nfind_package(MPI REQUIRED)\nfind_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)\nfind_package(CUDAToolkit REQUIRED)\n\nadd_executable(unstructured unstructured.cpp)\n\n# The single source file contains both host code and CUDA kernels\nset_source_files_properties(unstructured.cpp PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CUDA)\n\n# Enable optimizations\ntarget_compile_options(unstructured PRIVATE\n  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-O3 -march=native -Wall -Wextra>\n  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-O3 -Xcompiler=-march=native,-Wall,-Wextra,-fopenmp>\n)\n\ntarget_link_libraries(unstructured PRIVATE\n  MPI::MPI_CXX\n  OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX\n  CUDA::cudart\n  m\n)\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/unstructured_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_hybrid_r5/unstructured/CMakeLists.txt","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/unstructured_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_hybrid_r5/unstructured/CMakeLists.txt","time":{"start":1793157009956,"end":1793157009979}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_1807c8fc2001whiMSNYREtbJCZ","sessionID":"ses_e7f8712a0ffevs78WBsYrZHx2k","messageID":"msg_1807c7fc900148ktTWZL6uXg3B"}}

Now I want to double-check correctness for the oversubscribed case where np=8 runs across only 4 GPUs.\n\nThe edge case with N smaller than nranks passed fine with empty partitions, and I should do quick tests for -h, unknown options, and n=0 handling. The build was quiet with no warnings, which is good, and I used a /tmp build directory rather than one inside the repo to avoid creating new files, though a hidden test building in-repo should still work fine since we explicitly set -O3. The per-iteration throughput checks out too — roughly 3.6 billion elements/sec at the larger size, and launch overhead dominates at smaller sizes, which is expected. I also want to confirm the interior kernel properly syncs the boundary stream before the MPI call, and I'm now looking at a potential hazard around one of the async memory copies into the input buffer.\n\nChecking that the interior and boundary memory operations don't actually overlap in unsafe ways — the gather happens on the boundary stream but only after prior-iteration sync, so that's fine. {"type":"text","timestamp":1793157686057,"sessionID":"ses_e7f8712a0ffevs78WBsYrZHx2k","part":{"id":"prt_18086de91001AICBon93RXk7Cs","messageID":"msg_18086c6a5001I5Su4883KF8mT6","sessionID":"ses_e7f8712a0ffevs78WBsYrZHx2k","type":"text","text":"The benchmark is now hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA. Its output matches the original exactly, and it runs about 33x faster on one GPU and about 133x on four for a 4096x4096 grid.\n\n**Changed files** (only these two; nothing new in the repo):\n- `unstructured/unstructured.cpp`: rewritten. Same executable name and the same output format.\n- `unstructured/CMakeLists.txt`: now requires CMake 3.18 and finds MPI, OpenMP, and the CUDA toolkit. The source is compiled as CUDA so the kernels can live in the same file. The default architecture list is 70–90 and can be overridden with `-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES`.\n\n**How it's parallelized**\n- **MPI:** the element index space is block-partitioned across ranks. Each rank builds only its own slice. Ghost (halo) energies are exchanged point-to-point with the ranks that own them.\n- **CUDA:** one GPU per rank, assigned round-robin by node-local rank. The update is a kernel with the same arithmetic order as the original. Interior elements update on one stream while the halo exchange runs. Boundary elements update after the halo lands.\n- **OpenMP:** parallelizes the host-side mesh construction, connectivity, and ghost lookup. The per-step stencil is GPU-bound, so OpenMP is not on the hot path. I kept it there rather than inventing a CPU share of the work that would slow things down.\n\n**Verification**\n- I compared against a build of the original code on 10 grid/iteration configurations at 6 rank counts (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8). All 60 matched on the full results block, sample values, hash, and validation output.\n- Timings (100 iterations, time reported by the program):\n\n| Grid | Original | 1 rank / 1 GPU | 2 ranks | 4 ranks |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 4096x4096 | 15,825 ms | 468 ms | 240 ms | 119 ms |\n\n- The build is clean with `-Wall -Wextra`. Testing was on this machine only (4x RTX 3090, CUDA 12.0, OpenMPI). I did not test on a multi-node cluster.\n\n**Behavior changes to be aware of**\n- Grid size `-n` below 1 is now rejected with an error. The original had undefined behavior there.\n- The final state is gathered to rank 0 outside the timed region. The hash, validation, and `-r` output need the full state in one place, so rank 0 holds O(N) memory at the end.\n- Device indices are 32-bit per rank (local plus ghost elements must stay below about 4.3 billion).\n- Ranks that share a GPU run correctly, but oversubscription is slow. Use one rank per GPU for the best performance.","time":{"start":1793157684881,"end":1793157686053}}}
